children: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (NSE:HAL) won a $27B-ish HAL order for 138 Advanced Light Helicopters adding ~13% to backlog with $600M advances, while clearing engine shortages to push Tejas/HTT-40 deliveries; shares rose as technicals show accumulation and bullish momentum.
DAC Clears Purchase Of 138 HAL Helicopters
: DAC cleared purchase of 138 Advanced Light Helicopters from HAL. Order adds ~13% to backlog (~$27B); ~$600M cash advances. Mk-1A deliveries begin H2; shares rose ~2–4% intraday.
HAL Airframes Await Engines, Tejas Deliveries In 12–15 Months
: HAL has 20+ completed airframes awaiting engines. GE supplied only 10 engines for FY27 (three in August). HAL expects at least 10 Tejas deliveries in the next 12–15 months.
HAL To Deliver HTT-40 Trainers To IAF
: HAL to deliver first three HTT-40 trainers to IAF (two Bengaluru, one Nashik). IAF ordered 70 in 2023; HAL had delivery delays due to Honeywell TPE331-12B engine shortages, now being addressed.
HAL Weekly Moving Average Breakout; Positive Accumulation

: HAL held its weekly long-term moving average during a pullback, broke out of a triangle, stays above the 20‑week EMA, shows positive short‑to‑mid structure and healthy volume indicating accumulation.
